mcqs.q: A single 50-mg/kg oral dose of gabapentin given before a veterinary visit significantly reduced which measure in dogs versus placebo?
mcqs.e: Only lip licking frequency was significantly lower with gabapentin during all examination phases.

mcqs.q: How did greeting score, eye surface temperature, and salivary cortisol compare between gabapentin and placebo groups?
o: All were significantly lower with gabapentin
All were significantly higher with gabapentin
mcqs.e: These greeting and physiological variables showed no substantial difference between groups.

mcqs.q: What was the safety conclusion for the 50-mg/kg gabapentin dose in healthy dogs?
o: Well tolerated without serious adverse effects
mcqs.e: Owners reported no serious adverse events; the dose was well tolerated.

mcqs.q: In this pilot trial, behavioural improvement in cats given venlafaxine compared with placebo was:
mcqs.e: Improvement was significantly higher in the venlafaxine group, as early as day 30 by veterinarian scoring.

mcqs.q: What effect did venlafaxine have on cats' compliance with carrier removal and manipulation?
mcqs.e: Neither removal nor manipulation scores differed significantly between groups.

mcqs.q: Which adverse effect was the main reported finding with venlafaxine over 60 days?
mcqs.e: Adverse effects were limited to drowsiness in one cat; treatment was otherwise well tolerated.

mcqs.q: In the waiting room, the DAP gel was significantly associated with a reduction in which behaviour?
mcqs.e: DAP significantly reduced lip licking (and increased panting) in the waiting room.

mcqs.q: What did the study find regarding behavioural and physiological responses in the examination room?
o: No significant behavioural or physiological differences
mcqs.e: In the examination room, neither behavioural nor physiological differences were found.

mcqs.q: How did salivary cortisol and other physiological measures respond to DAP overall?
mcqs.e: No significant differences were observed in the physiological responses.

mcqs.q: Gabapentin was synthesized as a structural analogue of which neurotransmitter?
mcqs.e: It is a GABA-mimetic analogue able to cross the blood-brain barrier.

mcqs.q: In cats, gabapentin showed efficacy in which settings according to this review?
mcqs.e: In cats it was effective for post-ovariohysterectomy pain and anxiety.

mcqs.q: How is gabapentin used in veterinary medicine?
o: Extra-label, often in combination with other drugs
mcqs.e: It is used extra-label, typically combined with other treatments.

mcqs.q: What proportion of dogs in this case series improved with mirtazapine?
mcqs.e: Eighty-one percent of dogs showed improvement, with mild tolerable adverse effects.

mcqs.q: Prior to this report, mirtazapine was marketed in cats primarily as a(n):
mcqs.e: Mirtazapine is marketed as an appetite stimulant in cats.

mcqs.q: What was the authors' overall conclusion about mirtazapine for canine anxiety-related problems?
mcqs.e: Mirtazapine appears suitable and safe for anxiety-related behavioural problems in dogs.

mcqs.q: Which pathogen was the most prevalent CIRD agent detected during this Texas shelter outbreak?
mcqs.e: CDV was found in 12 of 15 dogs and all kennels, making it the primary pathogen.

mcqs.q: How did coughing change once intake vaccination coverage reached at least 90%?
mcqs.e: Coughing dropped significantly (~7%) when vaccination was at least 90% versus below 90%.

mcqs.q: What does this study support regarding shelter welfare?
o: Intake vaccination can substantially reduce illness
mcqs.e: Implementing vaccination on intake substantially reduced illness, supporting its importance.

mcqs.q: For how long did this dog shed canine distemper virus, the longest documented canine infection?
mcqs.e: The dog excreted CDV (PCR-positive urine) for 17 months.

mcqs.q: What concurrent vector-borne co-infection was present in this dog?
mcqs.e: The persistent CDV infection occurred alongside a Dirofilaria immitis heartworm co-infection.

mcqs.q: Phylogenetic analysis placed this CDV strain in which genetic lineage?
mcqs.e: Hemagglutinin gene analysis identified the endemic Arctic-like lineage.

mcqs.q: How did asymptomatic CIRD pathogen carriage compare between shelter dogs and client-owned dogs?
o: Higher in shelter dogs for all pathogens tested
mcqs.e: For all eight shared pathogens, positivity was higher among shelter dogs.

mcqs.q: What proportion of asymptomatic client-owned dogs were positive for at least one CIRD pathogen?
mcqs.e: 15 of 133 (11.3%) asymptomatic client-owned dogs carried at least one pathogen.

mcqs.q: Carriage risk differences between shelter and client-owned dogs were strongest for which pathogens?
o: M. cynos and canine respiratory coronavirus
mcqs.e: The association was strongest for M. cynos and canine respiratory coronavirus.

mcqs.q: What was the utility of skin immunohistochemistry for diagnosing CDV in raccoons?
o: Useful even in grossly and histologically normal skin
mcqs.e: IHC of skin aided CDV diagnosis even when skin appeared grossly and histologically normal.

mcqs.q: Which CDV receptor was found co-distributed with viral targets in raccoon skin?
mcqs.e: Nectin-4 was codistributed with the cellular targets of CDV infection.

mcqs.q: The authors suggest CDV-infected raccoon skin secretions and hair may act as:
mcqs.e: Skin secretions, shed keratinocytes, and hair are potential environmental fomites.

mcqs.q: What CDV seroprevalence was found in domestic dogs at the Janos wildlife interface?
mcqs.e: 62% of domestic dogs were seropositive for CDV.

mcqs.q: CDV antibody presence was significantly higher in which dogs?
mcqs.e: Seropositivity was higher in free-roaming owned dogs than in movement-restricted dogs.

mcqs.q: What was the reported CDV vaccination rate in these dogs?
mcqs.e: Vaccination against CDV was low at 7%, likely perpetuating viral circulation.

mcqs.q: What radiographic finding in juvenile dogs should raise suspicion of canine distemper virus?
mcqs.e: Multifocal symmetric metaphyseal sclerosis without lysis was characteristic of CDV.

mcqs.q: CDV-associated metaphyseal sclerosis was described as distinct from which condition?
mcqs.e: Sclerosis from CDV differs from the necrosis and inflammation of metaphyseal osteopathy.

mcqs.q: Where was the metaphyseal sclerosis most apparent in these dogs?
mcqs.e: Sclerosis was most apparent at the proximal humeral diaphyses and other long bones.

mcqs.q: In which dog group was CDV detection frequency highest in Southern Italy?
mcqs.e: Imported dogs had the highest CDV frequency (18.3%) versus stray (7.4%) and household (3.9%).

mcqs.q: Sequenced CDV strains in this study belonged to which clade?
mcqs.e: The viruses belonged to the Arctic clade already reported in Italy and Europe.

mcqs.q: What control measure did the authors emphasize to prevent CDV introduction?
mcqs.e: They highlighted the need for strict controls on dog importation from endemic countries.
